entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: The 421-residue sequence has 55.4–56.0% identity and 98.8–99.0% query coverage to reviewed bacterial kynureninases Q5WKB5, Q81PP8, and Q6HHX7; E-values are 3.84e-172 to 2.32e-166.
The sequence contains Pfam Aminotran_5 (PF00266.26; residues 80–346) and KYNU_C (PF22580.3; residues 312–401), supporting kynureninase-family membership.
Homolog annotations identify pyridoxal 5'-phosphate as cofactor and EC 3.7.1.3 kynureninase activity; exact substrate specificity remains homology-based for this query sequence.

entities.name: Kynureninase activity
observations: The inferred primary activity is PLP-dependent beta-elimination/cleavage of L-kynurenine to anthranilate and L-alanine.
The corresponding curated homolog reaction is L-kynurenine + H2O = anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+), Rhea RHEA:16813, EC 3.7.1.3.
The same enzyme family can cleave 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate and L-alanine, Rhea RHEA:25143.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: Reviewed kynureninase homologs are annotated as PLP-dependent enzymes, with a conserved modified lysine serving as the PLP attachment site; the query is inferred to use the same cofactor chemistry.

entities.name: L-kynurenine cleavage
observations: Curated reaction: L-kynurenine + H2O = anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+). Rhea RHEA:16813; EC 3.7.1.3.

entities.name: 3-hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: Curated reaction: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O = 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H(+). Rhea RHEA:25143; associated with the same kynureninase family.
